description: A pressurised wand sprayer with a stubby brass lance and a tank you wear.
name: pressure fumigator

tags.description: A shoulder tank feeding a stubby brass lance through a hose that has been re-clamped more times than is strictly reassuring. Pump the handle, the needle climbs into the red, and the lance throws a cone of something the label calls a REGULATED AGRICULTURAL COMPOUND and the trade calls the good stuff. It does nothing at all to a person wearing a mask, and a great deal to anything breathing through its sides.
